name: Aspendale Presbyterian Church
description: Aspendale Presbyterian Church is proud to be a local church. We love Jesus, love our community, love the Bible and love visitors. Our Sunday services are at 10am. We are a community of Christians who meet in Aspendale each week. We meet to hear God's truth from the Bible, encourage and support each other, and to practically live out the difference Jesus makes. As a Presbyterian church the church is lead by local elders. The Presbyterian Church originated in Scotland but welcomes all people today. Our Activities Each week we have a Sunday service at 10am with Kids Sunday School where all are welcome.  We also run bible studies, Kids clubs, playgroups, youth group, community events, prayer meetings and community meals.

name: Aspendale Probus Club
description: We are a local Probus club which is an association of retired and semi-retired professionals. We have monthly meetings at the Aspendale Gardens Community Service on the third Monday of each month starting at 10.00am.

name: Austin 7 Club Inc Reg No A0003290N
description: We are a one make Vintage Car club and provide sporting and social events, displays and runs for our members. We support the restoration and have activities for owners and supporters of all models of Austin 7 cars that were built from 1923 to 1938 by obtaining parts and technical help to keep the marque alive. Based in Cheltenham. We have 400+ members of all ages. It has always been a family club. Ladies and children are very welcome. The majority of members are in Victoria and many others from interstate with a few international members. We support all models of Austin 7's and encourage the younger members in learning the traditional skills in maintaining these older motor vehicles and their learning their history. The club runs rallies around Victoria and also join in with interstate clubs for other runs. The club has Full, Family and also Associate membership's if you don't own an Austin 7. All welcome. Our Monthly General Meeting is on the 1st Wednesday of the month except January. Meetings at 8pm The rooms open from 7:30pm for nibble & natter. The Saturday following the MGM at Noon-2:30 we open up Spare Parts & nibble & natter until 2:30 pm. And on the 3rd Wednesday 7:30-9pm for Spare parts, social chat with tea and coffee. See website www.austin7club.org.

name: Bayside Bicycle Touring Club Inc
description: We are a recreational cycling club based in Mordialloc, but membership is open to people from across Melbourne. Our rides are organised and conducted with most rides ideally suited to the novice and average cyclist with the emphasis of supporting and encouraging new members. We are not a competitive club and we welcome all riders. Our rides always have one thing in common: people enjoying cycling. Come and join us for healthy outdoors exercise with the companionship and security of a group. Meet new and interesting people with a common interest in cycling. name: Bayside Community Care
description: Bayside Community Care is dedicated to supporting the most vulnerable members of our community. Our mission is to empower individuals, foster meaningful connections and affirm their value as integral members of society. We achieve this by providing compassionate care and practical relief to those facing challenging circumstances. We provide two programs: Matt's Place Community Meals Program and Food Relief. Matt's Place Community Meals Program provides nutritious meals and social connections for people experiencing food insecurity, homelessness and social isolation. Each week, Matt's Place serves a two-course meal across two locations in Cheltenham and Chelsea, ensuring individuals and families facing hardship have reliable access to food and companionship. All are welcome to attend Matt's Place. The Food Relief program provides non-perishable pantry staples to those facing economic hardship. Hampers are available on a fortnightly basis. Recipients must live in the city of Kingston and be able to present a Healthcare Card is necessary.

name: Carrum Surf Life Saving Club
description: Welcome to Carrum Surf Life Saving Club! Celebrating 100 Years of service to the Carrum and surrounding communities. Carrum SLSC's mission is to keep the community and visitors in Carrum, Patterson Lakes, and surrounds, free from aquatic-related deaths and injuries. Our club is made up purely of volunteers - if you can help us out, please get in touch! We're a registered charity & affiliated with Life Saving Victoria, Surf Life Saving Australia & Royal Life Saving.

name: Country Women's Association (CWA) Dingley Village Branch
description: Country Women's Association (CWA) of Victoria Inc is a non-party and non-sectarian organisation for all city and country women. The Dingley Village branch is just one of over 360 branches throughout the state. This group is open to women of all ages who are interested in enhancing the community in which they live. CWA encourages women of all ages to respond to the needs of the community they live in as well as becoming involved in projects that may be state wide. We care by responding to the needs of others. We participate by becoming involved in community activities. We believe in equity in the provision of our services. We provide leadership, guidance and direction. We respect ideas, potential and contribution. We provide our services in a friendly, courteous manner. We support innovation and develop skills. We meet at 10am in the Dingley Village Neighbourhood Centre, 31b Marcus Road Dingley Village on the 4th Wednesday of each month except in December. We also have a craft group that meets on the 2nd Wednesday of the month at 10am at the Dingley Village Neighbourhood Centre.

name: DerDieDas Inc.
description: DerDieDas offers German language opportunities for bilingual children with a German-speaking background. Our philosophy is to create a fun, welcoming and supportive environment for children to form friendships, practice their German and get to enjoy German cultural celebrations. We offer the KiGa program which is a German language playgroup for children aged 3 - 5 years. The program is facilitated by a German kindergarten teacher (native speaker). Each term the German speaking children learn about different topics through group activities such as a morning circle, German songs, stories, games and artwork.

name: Dingley Village Senior Citizens Club
location: Harold Box Hall, DINGLEY Village Neighbourhood Centre
description: This Seniors Club offers a diverse array of engaging activities designed to foster social interaction among our esteemed members. Our regular activities are board games, playing cards and quizzes. Additionally, this year the group have enjoyed the bus trips to various attractions such as Werribee Open Zoo, A Ride on Arthur Seat Gondola and Mornington Peninsula for lunch ensuring a rich experience that promotes wellness and happiness. Events Celebrating: Mother’s Day. Father’s Day, Christmas in July and the Gala Christmas party. We invite new members to join our vibrant club, where every individual is valued and empowered to contribute to and benefit from a shared journey of exploration and friendship.

name: Edithvale Life Saving Club
description: Edithvale Life Saving Club was founded in 1919. ELSC has a proud history as an active club, performing many rescues, first aid treatments and reuniting parents with their lost children during the patrol season. The original clubhouse stood until 2019, when it was replaced by our new, current building. Our members consist of family groups, children, teenagers and adults all with one thing in common: a love of our beach. With a passionate committee and membership group, we are committed to upholding the longstanding tradition of protecting the public on our beach. We are always happy to welcome new members and welcome your participation with our club. More information can be found at edithvalelsc.com.au

Our members consist of family groups, children, teenagers and adults all with one thing in common: a love of our beach. With a passionate committee and membership group, we are committed to upholding the longstanding tradition of protecting the public on our beach. We are always happy to welcome new members and welcome your participation with our club. More information can be found at edithvalelsc.com.au

We don't offer gift cards or bill payment services but can refer you to agencies in Kingston who do. Pick up only. Delivery service is not available.

name: Heatherton Dingley Uniting Church
description: We seek to connect people to God and each other. Come join us on Sundays at 10am for our traditional church service, which is also live streamed on YouTube. Unleash the Music group is on the 2nd and 4th Thursday nights of each month at 7.30pm. It's a fun musical group for all types of people to play or sing popular music from the past. Bark and Chat Morning Tea for dog owners, dog lovers and their dogs is on the 3rd Saturday at 10am in Jan, Mar, May, July, Sept, with an annual Dog Church service on the 3rd Sunday of Nov at 10am. More information about our church and activities can be found on our website at: https://heathertondingley.ucavictas.org.au/

name: Melbourne PC User Group
description: Melbourne PC User Group (MelbPC) is a volunteer run not-for-profit association that has run successfully for over 40 years. Who? We’re an inclusive community of learners, makers and sharers who enjoy a wide cross-section of technology, STEAM and creative interests, in both the physical and digital realms. Why? It is affordable, accessible, welcoming and fun with benefits available via a mix of in-person, hybrid and dedicated online resources, projects and events. Where? Our main hub is in Moorabbin (opp. Bunnings), with connected groups based in Melbourne’s Northern and Eastern suburbs, and Sunbury. Our clubrooms are amazing! Our motto is, Members Helping Members! Before visiting us, call (03) 9276 4000 or check our Event Calendar

name: Mentone Community Assistance and Information Bureau Inc
description: Mentone Community Assistance and Information Bureau (MCAIB) is a community based registered charity that is operated by trained volunteers. Our mission is to assist members of our local community, particularly those experiencing personal and/or financial difficulties, by providing information, referral and support services, including our Emergency Relief Welfare Program. MCAIB aims to uphold the dignity of our community’s most vulnerable members by offering assistance that is free, confidential and impartial. We provide assistance and support to individuals and families within our local community needing help with a range of personal and financial matters. Our Services Include : • The provision of direct emergency relief (financial and material aid) to local residents who are in financial hardship due to a range of reasons, including inadequate income, sickness, domestic violence or homelessness. • Providing information, advocacy and referral services to assist local residents who are in necessitous circumstances. • Promoting financial capability by assisting clients with budgeting and financial literacy. • Facilitating a free legal advisory service and a Tax Help service. The following assistance is available: Client catchment postcode areas: 3195, 3194, 3192* *between Centre Dandenong Road and Mordialloc Creek

name: Mentone Horse & Pony Club
description: Mentone Pony Club was established in 1958, making it one of the longest-running pony clubs in the region. Since then we’ve been dedicated to fostering a love of horses and equestrian sports among young riders aged 5 to adults. From our humble beginnings, we've grown into a vibrant and inclusive club that welcomes riders of all ages and abilities. Our focus has always been on learning, safety, teamwork, and fun—values that continue to shape our club today. Many of our past members have gone on to compete at high levels or remain involved in the equestrian world, and we’re proud to be a part of their journey. Our club is a supportive and fun community where riders of all ages and skill levels come together to learn, grow, and enjoy their love of horses. Whether you're just starting out or have years of experience, there's a place for you in our club. Come ride with us, make new friends, and be part of something special! We cater for families with their own ponies.

Since then we’ve been dedicated to fostering a love of horses and equestrian sports among young riders aged 5 to adults. From our humble beginnings, we've grown into a vibrant and inclusive club that welcomes riders of all ages and abilities. Our focus has always been on learning, safety, teamwork, and fun—values that continue to shape our club today. Many of our past members have gone on to compete at high levels or remain involved in the equestrian world, and we’re proud to be a part of their journey. Our club is a supportive and fun community where riders of all ages and skill levels come together to learn, grow, and enjoy their love of horses. Whether you're just starting out or have years of experience, there's a place for you in our club. Come ride with us, make new friends, and be part of something special! We cater for families with their own ponies.

name: Mentone Probus Club
address: Mentone Life Saving Club, Beach Road, Mentone 3194
description: Mentone Probus Club is about all about fun, friendship and fellowship in our local community. We meet on the third Tuesday of every month at 10am (followed by a catered lunch at 12 noon), at the beautiful Mentone Lifesaving Club. We’re a newly established Probus Club (started in March 2025), now with over 100 members from around bayside (male, female and couples, mainly in our 60’s and 70’s), who enjoy socialising, getting out and about, and having a few laughs. Unfortunately, our club is full at the moment so we're currently placing prospective new members on a waiting list. If you’d like to know more about our club or join our waiting list please get in touch via email at enquiries@mentoneprobus.org.au or visit our website at http://www.mentoneprobus.org.au.

name: Mordialloc & District Historical Society
description: For 60 years our Society has collected, preserved and displayed thousands of important items of local history, ie: relevant to Mordialloc, Parkdale and Mentone. We operate Kingston's only historical museum which is located behind the Mentone shops and is open to the public on Sundays from 11am - 3pm.

name: Mordialloc Jazz Orchestra
description: MoJO is a 35 piece community band that plays transcriptions of classic and modern swing and big band tunes. At a MoJO performance you'll hear music from great artists like Glenn Miller, Count Basie, Michael Bublé, Etta James, Ella Fitzgerald, and so many more! There's always a chance to have a dance, so make sure you bring your best dancing shoes. Or maybe you'd prefer to just sit back, listen to the music, and be transported back to the great era of the big bands. The band performs around 30 events per year, the highlights of which undoubtedly are the Big Bands Sunsets Festival held on each Saturday in February and the Jazzeoke series that takes place throughout the year, where anyone can get up and sing - karaoke - with a live jazz band! MoJO has a strong commitment to developing musicians no matter what stage they are at in their musical journey. Most of all though, MoJO is renowned for its ability to bring 'fun' into the music. You will always go away from a MoJO performance with a smile on your face. Their light-hearted rapport with the audience combined with their great 'swinging' music makes them one of the most well-supported community ensembles in the country.

name: Mordialloc Men's Shed
description: Mordialloc Men's Shed is a friendly and welcoming gathering place open to all men regardless of interests, age or background.  New members always welcome! We are a small, social shed.  Come along and make new friends, engage in conversation, enjoy good coffee and a biscuit, play pool or cards, venture into the workshop to work on your own or community projects, partake in occasional excursions. We are located at 1 McDonald Street, Mordialloc , right next the railway line on the Nepean Hwy side, just 200 metres from Mordialloc Station. We are open on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday mornings from 9:00 am to 12:00 noon. You are most welcome to come and visit at any time to see if we are what you are looking for or contact us on 0421 151 284.

name: Parkdale Tennis Club
address: Cnr Imes and Chandler Streets, Parkdale 3195
description: Parkdale Tennis Club has courts available to hire for Parkdale Tennis Club members and non members. Social tennis: Wednesday night, Thursday & Friday morning and Sunday afternoon for members and non members. Inhouse competition: Tuesday and Thursday nights for members and non members. Interclub competition: Saturday & Sunday morning (juniors) and Saturday afternoon (adults) members only. Coaching: Monday to Friday from 3.30pm for children and adults. Other times by appointment.

name: Probus Club of Dingley Central
location: Salvation Army Kingston Gardens Community Church
description: If you are retired, whether you are male or female, you are invited to come along as a visitor to the Probus Club of Dingley Central on the first Monday of the month at 10 a.m. to see why this Probus Club is so popular. You will be entertained by guest speakers and listen to shared stories. You can also join a coffee/chat group, visit local cafés or go for lunch with like-minded people. You can join the craft group, connect with passionate card players or display your photographic skills. Trips and outings are also very popular. Probus is non-political, non-sectarian and non-profit. The major difference between Probus and many other community clubs is that Probus focuses on friendship, not fundraising. We aim to enrich members’ lives through social connection, engaging activities and shared experiences.

description: Radio Carrum is an online community radio station broadcasting from deep in the heart of Karrum Karrum, where amazing people from across the City of Kingston and beyond share their findings and passions with our local and international audience. If you are interested in launching your own live show or podcast on Radio Carrum, or have an idea you’d like to explore with us, please let us know! name: Rotary Club of Mordialloc Mentone
description: The Rotary Club of Mordialloc Mentone is active in the local community of Mordialloc, Parkdale & Mentone,  fundraising to support charitable organisations, and partnering with organisations such as the Mordialloc Neighbourhood House, Men's Shed, Salvation Army at Dingley, Fight Parkinson's support group and providing sponsorship for school students to attend Rotary programs. We run a market at the old Mentone Heritage Railway station once a month and put on an annual Gnome & Fairy Festival in March. Heart History Health Walks and a Chatty Cafe at Just Italy in Mentone are some of the many activities supported by the Club. These local projects stand alongside a number of international programs, disaster aid, as well as bushfire and flood relief. Interested in joining? You are welcome to come along to a meeting, most Tuesdays at the Mentone RSL, 6.30pm.

name: Rotary Club of Oakleigh Clayton Huntingdale
description: The Rotary Club of Oakleigh Clayton Huntingdale Inc formed in 2019 when the Rotary clubs of Oakleigh, Clayton and Huntingdale merged to create a new and stronger Club within the cities of Monash and Kingston. With over 160 combined years of service and experience, the Club, Rotary OCH, is definitely well placed to continue the good work of Rotary and to make your community a better place to live. Rotary OCH brings together a team of men and women who meet weekly on Monday evenings from 6.30pm at 319 Clayton Road, Clayton. As a part of Rotary OCH, members and guests enjoy friendship, community service, networking, social activity and personal development through participation in local and international projects. And always doing it with fun. The main fundraiser of Rotary OCH is the Oakleigh Rotary Sunday Market which started more than 30 years ago, and has evolved into a thriving and well-loved local event that brings the community together every Sunday morning. name: Senior Citizens of the Freccia Azzurra Club Inc.
description: We're a senior citizens group that meet every Tuesday from 9:30am to 4:30pm to socialise with friends and have a good time at the cost of $20 for a 3 course meal for both members and non-members. There is also the option to stay for dinner on a Tuesday and order from our à la carte menu. We partake in several activities such as Bocce, Bingo, Italian Card Games and Table Tennis, as well as occasionally taking day trips. On the last Tuesday of the month from 12:00pm to 4:30pm we have a formal lunch and dance with an Italian band and a 3 course meal at $35 for members of our group, and $40 for non-members. Stay tuned to our Facebook page for all other events that we organise.

name: Speaking Made Easy Bayside
description: Bayside Women’s Public Speaking Group Meetings held 1 st and 3 rd Wednesday each month, 8.15pm at Sundowner Community Centre, Clarinda. Welcoming group of women who learn and practise public speaking in a relaxed, non-competitive, supportive environment. Have you always wanted to feel comfortable and confident speaking in a group situation? Come along and see for yourself.

name: St Matthew's Anglican Church, Cheltenham
address: Cnr Nepean Highway and Park Road, Cheltenham 3192
description: St Matthew's Anglican church has been a centre of worship in Cheltenham for over 150 years. We experience God’s hospitality through meeting together, praying for each other and for God’s world, and sharing in rituals that help to strengthen our spiritual lives.  Our worship style is traditional Anglican (Anglo-Catholic) with music and children's ministry a regular feature. God's love does not discriminate, and our church is a welcoming and inclusive place for all people. We offer regular services on Sunday at 9.30am and Wednesday at 9.45am, as well as celebrations to mark special days in the Christian calendar. Members of the community also have the opportunity to mark life events such as baptisms, weddings and funerals.  Our beautiful mid-century church is in the heart of Cheltenham, on the corner of Park Road and Nepean Highway. We operate Cheltenham Opportunity Shop in the building next to our church at 161 Park Road Cheltenham, and other spaces within our church buildings are available for use by community organisations, including Matt's Place community meals program, which operates from our Church hall on Thursdays.

name: St Nicholas Anglican Church Mordialloc
description: We meet every Sunday at 9:15am for Holy Communion . Please join us after the service for morning tea fellowship. Things we do: Messy Church: an all-age, informal and fun way of doing Church that is particularly suited to families with children, but all are welcome,  is held on the fourth Sunday of the month except December - ( when there is a special "Messy Christmas Eve" at 5pm, and January when Messy is in recess) from 4.00 - 6.00 pm. Walk Pray Eat: on the 4th Saturday each Month, is a quiet reflective walk, finishing at various cafes for Breakfast, coffee/tea, or just a catchup and fellowship. Mordialloc Pantry: trade your donation for something that can be of use to you. We could also organise a volunteer to collect your items if travelling isn't an option or life is too hectic. The Pantry Cabinet is accessible 24 hours a day. Bible Studies: Wednesday night at 8pm "In Person" bible study on the 2nd and 4th of each month. Please email us or visit our website for further information. ZOOM bible study is on 2nd and 4th Thursdays at 7.30pm. Pastoral Ministries: to the aged and unwell, Spiritual Direction, Weddings, Baptisms, and Funerals conducted by the Vicar and Pastoral Ministry Team.

name: When No One's Watching (WNOW) - Mentone Sunrise Club
description: WNOW creates environments where men feel safe to connect authentically, share openly and learn from their peers to enable them to be happier when they are by themselves and with their loved ones. We want to shake the perceived cultural expectations that are upon the modern man. We are saying it is ok to celebrate emotional vulnerability and be a good man. Its ok to grow and change out of your culturally accepted norm to be a better person for yourself and for the world around us. How do we do this? Sunrise Clubs, where we meet to do a simple workout / mindful movement, share stories, have a dip in the ocean, and most importantly have a coffee and connect with one another. We create a safe, non-judgmental environment where everyone is welcome regardless. Every Wednesday. 6AM. Rain Hail or Shine. Next to Mentone LSC. WNOW is a ACNC registered charity with DGR status ( https://www.acnc.gov.au/charity/charities/dcfb107e-8724-ef11-840b-00224893bffb/profile )

name: YWCA Spring Park Golf Club Inc
address: Crn Lower Dandenong Rd & Centre Dandenong Rd, Dingley Village 3172
description: We welcome all ladies who have completed lessons & have the basic skills & knowledge of golf. We play nine holes Monday mornings at 7.45am - 10.30am at Spring Park Golf Course, (03) 9551 5163.
